a few words from me

Dear Pranali,

I don't really know how to put everything I feel into words, but today I want to try.

It's your little things — the way you talk, your expressions, your smile, your laughter, your innocence, your way of understanding things, and even those tiny moments that probably seem completely ordinary to you.

The chocolates, the little gifts, the conversations, the bus rides, the random talks, the jokes, the moments when we laughed for no particular reason… somehow, all those simple things became special memories for me.

one important thing
“Whenever you need me, whenever you feel like talking, or whenever you simply need someone to stand beside you — you can always count on me.”

I may not always have the perfect words or the perfect solution, but whenever you genuinely need me, I'll always try to be there to help and support you.

my birthday wish for you

Keep smiling. Keep shining.

I hope you achieve everything you dream about. I hope life gives you countless reasons to be happy, peaceful and proud of yourself.

And no matter how much life changes, I hope you never lose the innocence, kindness and warmth that make you who you are.

“Some moments are very simple… but somehow, the heart remembers them forever.”

before you leave

One last little thing…

Thank you for being you, Pranali. Thank you for every conversation, every laugh, every tiny memory and every ordinary moment that somehow became special.

Whenever you need help, whenever you need support, or whenever you just need someone to listen — I'll always be there.

I will love you, always. ❤️
— From someone who genuinely wishes the best for you.
